rows.name: HUMOTO
rows.description: HUMOTO contains 4D data of human-object interactions, including 3D human poses and artists-made object meshes, and their temporal evolution. It features 735 sequences (7,875 seconds at 30fps), and 72 articulated parts. HUMOTO features Mixamo-compatible rigging and can be combined with eixisting Mixamo data.
